page: Microsoft Azure D96plds_v6 is an ARM64-based server belonging to the Dpldsv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated physical cores powered by Microsoft Neoverse-N2 processors operating at 3.4 GHz, with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The hardware profile includes 192.0 GB of RAM, yielding a compute-optimized allocation of 2.0 GB of memory per core. Additionally, the server comes bundled with 5669 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, though it does not include any GPU hardware.

In benchmark evaluations, the D96plds_v6 demonstrates top-tier multi-core performance, placing in the top 10% for stress-ng multi-core CPU tests, Geekbench multi-core scores, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth is also highly competitive, achieving top-tier results in both cached small-block and uncached large-block read/write operations. Conversely, single-core performance is moderate, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the average category. Database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput also rank in the top tier.

The qualitative cost efficiency of this server is driven by its high physical core density and bundled local storage, making it an efficient choice for scale-out workloads that do not require high memory-to-CPU ratios. The primary tradeoff is the lower memory allocation of 2.0 GB per core, which may limit memory-intensive databases. The server is highly suited for multi-threaded applications, software compilation, static web serving, and database operations.
